errors.evidence: The x-axis has a logarithmic scale, not a linear one. The tick marks are evenly spaced for values that double at each step (2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, etc.).
The legend uses the Greek letter gamma (γ), not the letter 'y'. This error is repeated for the other two data series as well.
The blue line starts at approximately 8.2 at the 2K context length, not 8.14.
The blue line's final value at 64K is approximately 7.78, not 7.80.
The orange line has circle markers, not triangle markers. All three lines in the plot use circle markers.
The orange line starts at approximately 8.2 at the 2K context length, not 7.92. All three lines start at roughly the same point.
The orange line's final value at 64K is approximately 7.73, not 7.76.
The green line has circle markers, not square markers. All three lines in the plot use circle markers.
The green line starts at approximately 8.2 at the 2K context length, not 7.88. All three lines start at roughly the same point.
The green line's final value at 64K is approximately 7.72, not 7.78. This is a significant error as it misrepresents the final ordering of the lines.
